{{Quote|That's it&mdash;shove them around a little! They're messing with the Raff Syndicate, now!|Nunk Plaarvin|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 37">[[Knights of the Old Republic 37|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 37]]</ref>}}
The '''Raff Syndicate''' was a criminal syndicate around the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The Raff Syndicate included the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Nunk Plaarvin]] and his many [[Chev]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] including [[Cipiter]]. The Raff Syndicate also hosted the [[Metellos Exchange]], a large illegal auction on [[Metellos 3]] that was crashed by [[Marn Hierogryph]] and his [[Cargryph Capital Management]] organization.

[[Slyssk]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] ship thief, was briefly a member before defecting to Cargryph Capital Management and following Hierogryph on his journeys.
